title: An extra degeneracy contracts an augmented simplicial set
statement:
Let $X$ be a simplicial set [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], let $S$ be a set, and let $\varepsilon:X\to\operatorname{const}S$ be an augmentation. Suppose there are maps $h_{-1}:S\to X_0$ and $h_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ for $n\geq0$ with
$$\varepsilon_0h_{-1}=1_S,\quad d_0h_n=1_{X_n},\quad d_1h_0=h_{-1}\varepsilon_0,$$
$$d_{i+1}h_{n+1}=h_nd_i\ (0\leq i\leq n+1),\qquad s_{i+1}h_n=h_{n+1}s_i\ (0\leq i\leq n).$$
These data are an extra degeneracy. The map $h_{-1}$ extends to a simplicial section $s:\operatorname{const}S\to X$ of $\varepsilon$, and there is a simplicial homotopy from $s\varepsilon$ to $1_X$. A simplicial homotopy means the usual family of degree-raising maps satisfying the face and degeneracy prism identities, equivalently a map $X\times\Delta^1\to X$ with the specified endpoints, where $(\Delta^1)_n$ is the set of order-preserving maps $[n]\to[1]$.
